fig1_lab_frame.svg: Worldlines x(t) of two bodies (m=2 and m=1) in the lab frame, with the centre-of-mass line from cm_velocity(). The CM drifts uniformly at V_cm = 0.33 m/s because no external force acts; the bodies move asymmetrically about it.
fig2_cm_frame.svg: The same event after a Galilean boost to the CM frame via galilean_position(): the centre of mass is now a vertical (stationary) worldline and the two bodies carry equal and opposite momenta, so the total momentum is P' = 0e+00 ~ 0.
